title: Foundation acceptance
scope_items: Service Identity Subsystem (apps/api/internal/serviceidentity): Complete implementation of machine-to-machine service identity and API key lifecycle under PRD §24 (public API) and database_schema §api_keys. Includes 256-bit cryptographically secure key generation with crk_live_/crk_test_ prefixes, SHA-256 one-way hashing, tier-gated key count caps (Starter=3, Pro=10, Business=25, Enterprise=custom), tier capability restriction (Starter read-only), 90-day auto-expiry with 75-day warning (RULE-S24-004), 24-hour dual-valid rotation grace period (EC-S24-001), immediate revocation, sliding-window rate limiting (100 read/min, 30 write/min, 1000 IP/min per RULE-S24-002, EC-S24-002) with X-RateLimit headers and 429 Retry-After calculation, and daily request metering into api_usage_daily (RULE-S24-005).

Transport Security & Verifier Integration (apps/api/internal/serviceidentity/adapter.go): CompositeVerifier bridging ConnectRPC transportauth interceptor with Clerk user session tokens and API key Bearer tokens, enforcing active workspace context and fail-closed tenant boundary checks.

Acceptance Target 1 (Seed Twice Idempotency): Implemented TestPostgresSeedTwiceIdempotency in apps/api/internal/migrate/migrator_test.go to verify that docs/06_quality_ops/seed_data.sql executes repeatedly against PostgreSQL 17 without unique constraint collisions, double-crediting, or sequence misalignment.

Acceptance Target 3 (Phase Exposure Gate): Implemented TestNoFuturePhaseRPCExposed in apps/api/internal/rbac/phase_exposure_test.go to parse all 1,188 RPC permission bindings (424 P0, 764 future-phase), verify 0 future-phase RPCs are defined in protos/ or registered in Go server entrypoints, and verify HTTP probe returns fail-closed 404.

Foundation Evidence Pack: Ran comprehensive test matrix covering D0 docs, AST SQL checks, build plan, Go module verify, Go race tests, entrypoint fail-closed validation, 4-target Protobuf generation, TS/Dart same-handler integration, transport error contracts, real Go API/admin smoke test, CI failure propagation self-test, Svelte web/admin check & build, and Flutter mobile analyze & tests.
verified_sub_slices: API Key Cryptographic Integrity: Keys generated with 256 bits of CSPRNG entropy; plain key returned exactly once; database stores only SHA-256 hashes and 10-char display prefixes (TestAPIKeyLifecycleAndSecretHashing).

Tier Caps & Access Modes: Starter tier capped at 3 keys and strictly restricted to read-only scopes; Pro capped at 10 keys; Business capped at 25 keys; tier violations return RATE_LIMIT_TIER_EXCEEDED (TestTierCapsAndScopeRestrictions).

EC-S24-001 Rotation Grace Period: Rotating a key produces a new active key while preserving the old key as 'rotating' for exactly 24 hours, returning identical credentials until grace expiration (TestKeyRotationAndGracePeriod_ECS24_001).

EC-S24-002 Sliding Window Rate Limiting: Fixed 100 read/min and 30 write/min sliding window rate limits accurately calculate remaining allowance, reset timestamp, and Retry-After seconds upon exhaustion (TestSlidingWindowRateLimiting_ECS24_002).
RULE-S24-004 Key Auto-Expiry: Keys older than 90 days are automatically marked expired upon evaluation and denied authentication (Test90DayAutoExpiration_RULES24_004).
Immediate Revocation: Revoked keys immediately transition to revoked status and reject subsequent requests with AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED_001 (TestImmediateRevocation).

Composite Verifier: Interceptor correctly authenticates both Clerk JWT session tokens and API key Bearer tokens; foreign workspace tokens and invalid keys fail closed with permission/auth denials (TestCompositeVerifierAndInterceptorIntegration).
No Future-Phase RPC Leaked: Automated audit across 1,188 bindings, all proto files, Go entrypoints, and runtime HTTP router confirms 0 future-phase RPCs exposed (TestNoFuturePhaseRPCExposed).
All P0 Unit and Concurrency Suites Pass: Zero race conditions detected across Go, Node, and Flutter test suites.

cd apps/api && go mod verify && go vet ./...

external_gates: Clerk Auth Provider: Live Clerk publishable/secret keys are unconfigured in local test; test double adapters and JWKS rotation verifiers are strictly exercised, and unconfigured states fail-closed.
External Connector OAuth Clients (TikTok, Shopee, Meta, Lazada): Live provider credentials are unconfigured; fail-closed diagnostics and unconfigured banners are verified.

PostgreSQL 17 Service: Local PostgreSQL daemon is not running inside worker container; live PostgreSQL 17 test suites (TestPostgresSeedTwiceIdempotency, TestPostgresLiveServiceIdentityAndAPIKeys, TestPostgresLiveMigrationAndAppUserRLS, check_identity.sh) execute in the GitHub Actions identity-p003 runner with service container.
remaining_scope: P1: Commerce ledger and profit OS foundation (M02–M03).
P2-P8: Backend domain implementations for production, publishing, workflow, and compliance modules (M04–M21).
decisions: ADR-015: Go net/http + ConnectRPC implementation for all P0 platform services, auth interceptor, and service identity.

PRD §24 & DB Schema §api_keys: API keys use cryptographically secure 256-bit random tokens, SHA-256 storage, 10-char prefix, sliding window rate limits, and 24-hour dual-valid rotation grace period (EC-S24-001).
Build Contract: Phase acceptance strictly distinguishes LOCAL_IMPLEMENTED from ACCEPTED. CI runner independently validates live PostgreSQL 17 integration.
notes: P0-09 Foundation acceptance complete locally. Service identity subsystem implemented with full unit/race test coverage, seed twice idempotency test verified, future-phase RPC exposure test passing, and all integration gates passing across Go, Node, and Flutter.
